newsitem.title: UK: NWE NAPHTHA FLAT IN QUIET, BALANCED MARKET.
newsitem.headline: NWE NAPHTHA FLAT IN QUIET, BALANCED MARKET.

text.p: NWE naphtha was thinly talked amid broadly steady prices on Monday, dealers said.
"It has been very quiet, with people away on holiday," said one who added that both sellers and buyers were both relaxed and under no immediate pressure to trade.

More action was seen on swaps with some fairly heavy trading on September. Several deals were concluded between $185.25 and $186.00. August swaps ranged around $190-191 failed to attract much interest.
A couple of trader shorts was the only sign of buying interest since end-users look well-covered.
